segregation.statement: No affected relative is reported. The pedigree figure text of 40574834 shows an asymptomatic-carrier symbol (†) in the family 21 panel, but the layout is garbled and the relative and genotype cannot be read reliably; the panel should check Supplementary Figure 1.

quotes.quote: Additionally, family analysis revealed that three cases with heterozygous variants were asymptomatic (penetrance: 95.7%).

functional.statement: Construct assay (36211342): myc-A20 variant constructs in HEK293T cells, NF-kB luciferase reporter after TNF-α stimulation, compared with WT and mock vector, in triplicate. The authors report that p.Gly583* was newly confirmed by this assay and that suppression of TNF-α-induced NF-kB activity by the variants was significantly lower than WT.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Nonsense change, predicted p.(Gly583Ter) per the batch HGVS. Both papers attribute the disease to heterozygous loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a systemic autoinflammatory disease caused by a heterozygous loss-of-function mutation in the TNF-α-induced protein 3 (TNFAIP3).
A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).

Determination of the patients’ genotypes and TNFAIP3 variants revealed several previously reported variants (32) and as well as two variants (p.Lys329Asn*1 and p.Gly583*) newly confirmed to be pathogenic using a NF-κB reporter gene activity assay (see the method of NF-κB reporter gene activity assay an Figure S2 in the electronic supplemental material).
All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: Same person: HA20-ID0213 (36211342 #3) and HA20-ID0734 (40574834 P37) are probably one individual: both female, onset 7 months, same variant, and 40574834 cites 36211342 (its reference 4) for P37. Count once.
Carrier possibly missing from the batch: an asymptomatic carrier symbol in the family 21 pedigree text of 40574834 (layout garbled).

Different change at the same codon: 40574834 Supplementary Table 6 lists c.1748_1749delinsCG / p.G583A among missense variants excluded after its functional analysis. That is not this variant; noted only to avoid confusion.
notes_for_panel: One girl reported twice. The functional data are a construct reporter assay; Figure S2 values are not readable in the text.
